name: @telicent-oss/git-pull-ignored-lib
//private: private until we get an npmjs.org package created
description: Pull a subdirectory of a git repository into a local gitignored directory, refusing any destination git does not ignore.
//main: the esm entry: this package is esm only, see vite.config.ts

..//types: first: conditions resolve in order, and only dist/index.d.ts is emitted

scripts.//dist: committed, so a git-pinned consumer needs no build on install. There is deliberately no prepare script
scripts.verify-dist: rm -rf ./dist && vite build && git diff --exit-code -- dist

devDependencies.//tsx: the git-missing test runs the source in a child process with no PATH
